label: SPATIOTEMPORAL_1: PartOfSpacetime F x:= F.partOf x F.whole: x is a part of the spacetime whole…
definition: `PartOfSpacetime F x := F.partOf x F.whole`: x is a part of the spacetime whole; whether parthood is improper (the whole a part of itself) is left to the supplied relation.
note: Stipulative. It fits Armstrong-style naturalism, on which the world is the space-time system and whatever exists belongs to it.
